risk_description: Offline synchronization logic using 'Last Write Wins' strategy may lead to data loss or user confusion during complex conflict scenarios (e.g., editing the same session on two devices offline).
affected_tasks: WI-BE-004 (Develop Tracking & Sync Module), WI-MOB-004 (Implement Offline Synchronization Service)
root_cause: Complexity of distributed state management and the inherent limitations of 'Last Write Wins' for non-atomic updates.
mitigation_strategy: Implement a rigorous integration test suite specifically for sync conflict scenarios. Add client-side logic to detect and warn users of potential conflicts or merge specific data fields intelligently rather than overwriting entire records.
contingency_plan: Implement a conflict resolution UI on the mobile client to allow users to manually choose the correct version if automatic resolution fails repeatedly.
monitoring_trigger: High rate of 409 Conflict responses or data integrity warnings in backend logs.

risk_description: Apple App Store or Google Play Store rejection due to non-compliance with In-App Purchase guidelines (e.g., restoring purchases, subscription terms display) or 'Sign in with Apple' requirements.
affected_tasks: WI-MON-002 (Implement Mobile IAP UI & Logic), US-005 (Sign in with Apple)
root_cause: Strict and frequently changing platform guidelines regarding monetization and authentication.
mitigation_strategy: Conduct a pre-submission audit against current App Store Review Guidelines. Ensure 'Restore Purchases' is prominent and subscription terms are explicitly stated on the paywall. Verify 'Sign in with Apple' is present if other social logins are used.
contingency_plan: allocate 2 weeks of buffer time in the release schedule specifically for addressing App Store rejection feedback.
monitoring_trigger: Rejection notice from App Store Review during TestFlight beta submission.

risk_description: Aurora Serverless v2 cost overruns due to improper scaling configuration or inefficient database queries preventing scale-down to 0.5 ACU.
affected_tasks: WI-INFRA-002 (Provision Aurora Serverless v2), WI-BE-004 (Tracking Module)
root_cause: Lack of connection pooling or long-running queries keeping the database active; misconfigured auto-scaling minimums.
mitigation_strategy: Configure strict auto-scaling policies in CDK. Implement EF Core query logging and optimization. Use RDS Proxy to manage connection pooling efficiently.
contingency_plan: Switch non-production environments to provisioned instances or schedule downtime to reduce costs.
monitoring_trigger: AWS Budgets alert for RDS exceeding 80% of monthly forecast within the first 10 days.

risk_description: Backend Webhook Handler for IAP fails to process notifications (e.g., RENEWAL, EXPIRATION) due to signature validation errors or provider API changes, leading to incorrect user subscription status.
root_cause: Complexity of validating disparate cryptographic signatures from Apple and Google; changes in webhook payload formats.
mitigation_strategy: Implement comprehensive unit tests using official sample payloads. Design the webhook handler to be idempotent. Set up a Dead Letter Queue (DLQ) for failed webhooks to ensure no event is lost.
contingency_plan: Develop a manual reconciliation script to query Apple/Google APIs for subscription status based on user reports.
monitoring_trigger: Increase in messages in the SQS Dead Letter Queue or 4xx/5xx responses on the webhook endpoint.

risk_description: Mobile dashboard performance degrades on older devices due to heavy main-thread processing of Isar database queries and Riverpod state updates.
root_cause: Complex widget trees rebuilding unnecessarily or synchronous database access on the UI thread.
mitigation_strategy: Enforce usage of `Isolate` for heavy database operations. Use `const` constructors for widgets. Implement rigorous performance profiling using Flutter DevTools on low-end devices.
contingency_plan: Refactor dashboard to load data lazily or paginate list views to reduce immediate rendering load.
monitoring_trigger: Frame drop rates > 5% on devices running Android 10 or lower during QA testing.

risk_description: Google Books API rate limiting or service unavailability disrupting the 'Add Book' feature functionality.
root_cause: Dependency on a third-party public API with strict quotas and no SLA guarantee.
mitigation_strategy: Implement aggressive caching of API responses in Redis. Use Polly for exponential backoff and circuit breaking. Implement a 'Manual Entry' fallback UI.
contingency_plan: Apply for a higher quota limit with Google or integrate a secondary book metadata provider (e.g., Open Library) as a failover.
monitoring_trigger: Circuit breaker state changes to 'Open' or high rate of 429 errors from Google Books API.

risk_description: SSRF vulnerabilities in the Image/URL fetching service used for article metadata extraction.
affected_tasks: US-040 (Add Article via URL), WI-BE-003 (Library Module)
root_cause: Allowing user-supplied URLs to be fetched by the backend server without strict validation.
mitigation_strategy: Implement strict allow-listing for protocols (http/https). Deny requests to private IP ranges (localhost, 10.x.x.x, etc.). Run the fetching service with least-privilege IAM roles.
contingency_plan: Disable the URL metadata fetching feature and require manual title/image entry until a secure patch is deployed.
monitoring_trigger: Security audit scanning revealing internal network calls initiated by the backend service.
